lines.text: A Psalm. A song for the Sabbath day.
It is good to praise the LORD,
and to sing praises to Your name, O Most High,
to proclaim Your loving devotion in the morning
and the melody of the lyre.
For You, O LORD, have made me glad by Your deeds;
I sing for joy at the works of Your hands.
How great are Your works, O LORD,
A senseless man does not know,
and a fool does not understand,
that though the wicked sprout like grass,
But You, O LORD, are exalted forever!

pictures.scene: Ilya Repin, Religious Procession in Kursk Province — the whole countryside walking out together behind the icon and the banners in the dust and the heat, a psalm, a song for the Sabbath day, it is good to praise the LORD
pictures.name: pd_repin_loven

pictures.scene: Claude Lorrain, Seaport with the Embarkation of the Queen of Sheba — the sun standing low over the water between the palaces while the boats are loaded at the quay, and to sing praises to Your name, O Most High, to proclaim Your loving devotion in the morning
pictures.name: pd_lorrain_morgen

pictures.scene: Adam Elsheimer, The Flight into Egypt — the family going on through the dark under the whole starry sky with the fire burning low beside the water, and Your faithfulness at night, with the ten-stringed harp
pictures.name: pd_elsheimer_nacht

pictures.scene: Henry Ossawa Tanner, The Banjo Lesson — the old man holding the instrument steady while the boy's hands find the strings, and the melody of the lyre, for You, O LORD, have made me glad by Your deeds
pictures.name: pd_tanner_snaren

pictures.scene: Frederic Edwin Church, The Icebergs — the green and white walls of ice standing up out of the still sea in the cold light, I sing for joy at the works of Your hands, how great are Your works, O LORD
pictures.name: pd_church_werken

pictures.scene: Johan Christian Dahl, View from Stalheim — the valley opening away below the crags with the rainbow standing over the far mountains, how deep are Your thoughts, a senseless man does not know
pictures.name: pd_dahl_gedachten

pictures.scene: Quentin Massys, Ill-Matched Lovers — the grinning old man taken in by the woman while the accomplice lifts his purse behind his back, and a fool does not understand, that though the wicked sprout like grass
pictures.name: pd_massys_dwaas

pictures.scene: Pieter Bruegel the Elder, Dulle Griet — the whole burning landscape of plunder and greed with the looters at their work before the mouth of hell, and all evildoers flourish, they will be forever destroyed
pictures.name: pd_bruegel_vernietigd

pictures.scene: The Master of Cefalù, Christ Pantocrator of Cefalù Cathedral — Christ filling the gold of the apse with His hand raised in blessing and the open book held out, the Virgin and the archangels standing far below Him, but You, O LORD, are exalted forever, for surely Your enemies, O LORD
pictures.name: pd_cefalu_verheven
